about_the_game:
Embark on a European getaway filled with puzzles and hidden object challenges! The Collins family’s trip to the Czech Republic sets the scene, but the real adventure lies in the variety of tasks waiting for you. Explore breathtaking locations inspired by real-world landmarks, uncover cleverly hidden objects, and solve a range of brain-teasing puzzles. From Prague’s iconic Charles Bridge to charming hidden alleyways, every scene offers a new challenge for your attention and logic.

Enjoy an exciting collection of puzzles: from classic hidden object scenes to unique mini-games. Each scene is a new test of observation, memory, and problem-solving skills. Keep an eye out for special collectibles to enhance your experience!

Featuring:

🔎 More than 50 hidden object scenes, each packed with detail and surprises!

🔎 Over 100 unique mini-games and brain teasers to test your logic and observation!

🔎 Extra content, including wallpapers and exclusive collectibles!

🔎 Beautifully illustrated locations inspired by real-world Czech landmarks!

🔎 Replayable puzzles – enjoy your favorite mini-games again and again!

🔎 Optional hint system – stuck on a tricky object? Use a hint to keep the adventure going!

🔎 Immersive soundtrack and ambient sounds that bring each scene to life!

Can you solve every puzzle and uncover all the hidden secrets along the way? Get ready for a holiday full of surprises!
